title: Fix Dag run partition key filter breaking on composite keys with |
body:
## Why
Composite partition keys join their parts with `|` (e.g. a key like `2026-06-15|us-east-1`). When a user filters Dag runs by such a key, the old behavior split on `|` and matched on the fragments instead of the whole key — so a perfectly valid composite key could never be found through the filter.

## What
`partition_key_pattern` and `partition_key_prefix_pattern` now treat `|` as a literal character rather than an OR separator. Adds `split_or=False` knob to `search_param_factory` and `prefix_search_param_factory`, threaded through `_SearchParam` and `_PrefixSearchParam`, applied only to the two partition-key params. Other `*_pattern` params keep the existing `|`-OR behavior unchanged.
